description: This is a Makefile for building the GCC toolchain component within an OpenWrt build system. It includes variable definitions, configuration options, patch management, and build rules specific to compiling and installing GCC with various configurations.

methods.name: Host/SetToolchainInfo
methods.description: Sets toolchain information by updating info.mk with target cross and GCC version.

methods.name: Host/Prepare
methods.description: Prepares the build environment, including creating directories and copying configuration files.

methods.name: Host/Configure
methods.description: Runs configure in the GCC build directory with specified configure options.

methods.name: Host/Clean
methods.description: Cleans up the build environment by removing build and stamp directories.
